sql: SELECT "schedule"."Cinema_ID" AS k, "schedule"."Price" AS m1 FROM "schedule" WHERE "schedule"."Price" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank schedule rows by ticket price
